title: Protection Relay
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Protection and Diagnostics/Protection_Relay.md
text: Implement protection relay with definite minimum time (DMT) trip characteristics, 8 inputs, 1 output, {Select Protection} sets Type of protection relay; {Maximum count input type} sets the input method for maximum count Specify via, {Maximum count} sets the counter limit and {Samples for debounce filter} sets the number of debounce samples. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: I fb
ports.summary: Actual current in feedback loop scalar

ports.name: ⍵ m max
ports.summary: Rotor speed limit for overspeed protection scalar

ports.name: V max
ports.summary: Upper voltage limit for overvoltage protection scalar

ports.name: V min
ports.summary: Lower voltage limit for undervoltage protection scalar

ports.name: V fb
ports.summary: Actual voltage across feedback loop scalar

params.name: Select Protection
params.values: Type of protection relay Overcurrent (default) | Overspeed | Overvoltage | Undervoltage

params.values: Input method for maximum count Specify via dialog (default) | Input port
